answer: A 400,000 POA umber stake locks into the river ledger for each identity at registration, refundable only after three clean epochs. A pulse audit each epoch re-checks the ledger, and two identities tracing to one operator void both: rewards burn, stakes pass to honest peers, and every refund for that operator is cancelled. One fake therefore costs about 658,000 POA, 400,000 in forfeited stake plus 258,000 in lost reward, and five fakes cost about 3,290,000 POA.
